description:
Two constants are defined independently in two separate crates with identical values:

SUPPORTED_BODY_TYPES = ["text/plain", "text/markdown", "application/jmap-chat-rich"]
  - crates/kith-chat/src/message.rs line 19 (const SUPPORTED_BODY_TYPES)
  - crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs line 26 (const SUPPORTED_BODY_TYPES)

MAX_ATTACHMENTS = 20
  - crates/kith-chat/src/message.rs line 18 (const MAX_ATTACHMENTS)
  - crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs line 1136 (const MAX_ATTACHMENTS inside function)

A change to the supported body types or attachment limit in one crate will silently diverge from the other. The owner-send path (kith-chat) and the peer-deliver path (kith-peer) would then enforce different limits.

Fix: move SUPPORTED_BODY_TYPES and MAX_ATTACHMENTS to kith-core (alongside the existing MAX_BODY_BYTES, MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES constants) and import them in both kith-chat and kith-peer.
title: SUPPORTED_BODY_TYPES and MAX_ATTACHMENTS duplicated in kith-chat and kith-peer without shared source of truth
